decision_rule: Recorded only, with no threshold and no pass-or-fail call: the number of directions holding 90, 95 and 99 percent of the spread in the per-count average vectors, at the chosen readout, at each of the probe windows 140, 200 and 280. The committed design gates on none of them at this rung, because the count is a property of the cutoff. The previous rung, at this same checkpoint, measured 1, 15 and 127 directions at one window across those three cutoffs.
metric: Directions holding 90, 95 and 99 percent of the spread in the per-count average vectors, at the chosen readout, per probe window.
notes: The counting convention is the smallest number of directions reaching a given share of the spread, which is every prior run's convention. All three cutoffs are recorded and none is gated at this rung. The design says why: the count is a property of the cutoff, and at one probe window the previous rung measured 1, 15 and 127 directions across the three cutoffs. The published pattern's own count of about 6 directions is carried above as context only. This check is recorded only. It carries no threshold and decides nothing, as the previous rung's gate record settles. If the floor gate recorded in these values failed, this record is void as evidence about the model, and is an instrument fault only. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
